answer: Bonded admission for AI agents: before an agent may bid for irrigation slots at a desert oasis's well, its operator must lodge one opal with the escrow custodian as a deposit. The deposit is per agent identity, so spawning a thousand sybil agents means locking up a thousand opals up front. An opal is forfeited permanently if auditors reviewing that agent's metered water draws in the public complaint thread find it took more than it reported. A sybil attacker's cost is every gem locked plus every gem lost.
